about_the_game:
Sentient Depths is a 3D action dungeon crawler set in a fantasy world. Explore a strange dungeon, battle a variety of stone golems, and master skill-based sword combat. Customize your playstyle through a flexible skill tree that lets you refine your abilities and adapt to any challenge.

Key Features

  • Skill-based combat: Execute a 3-hit combo, perform powerful special attacks, and chain parries and dashes for precise, satisfying battles.

  • Parry and dash mechanics: Time your defenses perfectly or evade attacks with invulnerable dashes.

  • Skill tree customization: Upgrade your combo, special attack, and parry to match your prefered playstyle.

  • Challenging enemies:

    • Melee Golem: Chases the player with his sword.

    • Ranged Golem: Attacks from afar with crystal projectiles.

    • Elite Golem: Wields a sword and is protected by a invulnerability shield.

  • Dungeon exploration: Fight through combat rooms and progress deeper into the dungeon.

    • This Demo only contains one dungeon.

Story:

A long time ago the gods were imprisoned in magical crystals. Without their presence and protection, dark forces and corruption took over the world.

In this sinister world, Elfrir sets out on a mission to better the life of his younger sister. With that motivation he attempts to join the Order of the Lotus, who have preserved knowledge about the prisons of the gods and how to free them. Since Elfrir doesn’t hold anything to his name but the clothes he wears, he has to master a challenge. Just for the chance to join the Order as a squire he has to clear out a dungeon on his own. He is provided with a simple sword and some basic training before he is sent into the Depths.

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce GTX 1080

short_description: Explore a mysterious dungeon, fight strong golems with skill-based sword combat, and upgrade your abilities to become unstoppable. Find the innermost part of the dungeon and reach the heart piece to destroy the dungeon.
